evidence.quote: Brightline would separately pay up to $4 million in court-approved fees and expenses; any amount not awarded would go to the class.
we can reduce the proposed class fund to $34 million and accept your $3 million fee figure, subject to court approval.
Whitcombe Reyes offers the lower total outlay and strong approval prospects. Counter modestly below its latest proposal while keeping Hargrove Lane engaged as an alternative.

summary: Class counsel raised fees in the initial proposals, and the parties negotiated fee amounts before settling the class fund. Defense kept the competing firm engaged while pursuing Whitcombe Reyes’s lower-total-outlay proposal. The record does not show a fee-for-class-relief tradeoff, and the declaration accurately describes the timing of fee discussions.
